macros.name: dimbox
macros.doc: \dimbox Typeset the type and dimensions of a box in the document.

macros.name: ShowGroups
macros.doc: The command \ShowGroups executes the primitive \showgroups but the compilation does not stop.

macros.name: ShowIfs
macros.doc: The command \ShowIfs executes the primitive \showifs but the compilation does not stop.

macros.name: ShowLists
macros.doc: The command \ShowLists executes the primitive \showlists but the compilation does not stop.

macros.name: viewbox
macros.doc: \viewbox Typeset the type and dimensions of a box in the document and inserts the content of that box.
